sources.description: Gem and ore nodes, locations and minimum pre-completion mine floors.
Gem drops, panning and treasure alternatives.
Mines foraging, geodes and Duggy drops.
Mine dirt on any floor or specified monster drops.
Tilling on floors 1-39 or four named monster drops.
Specified colored slimes, bats and other monsters can drop this scroll.
Tilling floors 80+ or monster drop subject to exclusions.
Iridium node, Mystic Stone, Magma/Omni geodes and other alternatives.
Lightning rod storms, solar panels, Traveling Cart, monster drops, fish pond.
Fish pond production; fishing treasure only with Jewels of the Sea power.
20-day tea bush, last seven days; winters indoors; Caroline 2 hearts recipe and purchase alternatives.
Volcano nodes, monsters, Stingray pond and special Skull Cavern source.
Skeleton/Lava Lurk drops, bone nodes, artifact spots and panning.
Dangerous Mines and dangerous Skull Cavern toggle/quest unlocks.
Five matching eligible items, next morning output, Pierre recipe and construction inputs.
Collect moss from actually moss-covered trees and green-rain weeds.
Mystic Tree with Tapper 7 days or Heavy Tapper 3 days.
One fish plus one coal; 50 minutes; recipe at Willy 10,000g.
Mystery and Golden Mystery Boxes with progressive odds, blue box threshold over 10.
Volcano skeletal remains, Lava Lurk 15% or Stingray pond at least 9.
Tree species produce seeds from shaking/felling or seed spots.
